title: Reforming the state: the Reforma in Mexico
goal: Read how Mexican liberals changed the law, the land and the constitution, and use the passive with ser to say what was approved and who was elected.

items: Use the passive with *ser* (*fue aprobada*, *fueron vendidas*) to say what the liberal reforms did.
Say what the Lerdo Law of 1856 required.
Say who Benito Juárez was and what happened in the Reform War.
Say what happened to Maximilian in 1867.
Use the key words of this lesson: reform, conservative, Zapotec, intervention, French and troops.
